paragraphs: Moshe bar Atzri the Kohen; Atzri’s grandson was Rav Huna, a young Torah scholar, as stated in [Bava Batra 174b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.174b.9).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Moshe bar Atzri and explicitly calls Rav Huna his son, so Atzri is Rav Huna’s grandfather.
Hyman places “the Kohen” after “Moshe bar Atzri.” [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2561&lang=en) attaches “the Kohen” to Rav Huna.
